records.issue_text: `save_host` dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` without checking the `embeddable_host` key exists, raising NoMethodError on nil when the key is missing
records.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code directly does `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` with no guard/`require`. If the request omits the `embeddable_host` key, `params[:embeddable_host]` will be `nil` and `[:host]` will raise `NoMethodError`. This dereference is present in the added controller code.

records.issue_text: The diff defines no Ember models for the `embedding` and `embeddable-host` types, so `store.find('embedding')` and `createRecord('embeddable-host')` will fail to resolve the type
The TLD portion of the host validation regex is limited to `{2,5}` characters, rejecting valid domains with longer TLDs like `.museum` or `.technology`
records.rationale: The diff introduces `EmbeddableHost` with `validates_format_of :host, with: /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The TLD is explicitly constrained to 2–5 letters (`[a-z]{2,5}`), which will reject valid longer TLDs such as `.museum` or `.technology`, preventing legitimate hosts from being saved/used.
